title: SyncQuiesceMonitorTests wall-clock sensitivity flakes at elevated rate as the suite grows

description: Filed by orchestrator after Wave 4b verification: two of four consecutive full-suite runs hit the documented flake classes (SyncQuiesceMonitorTests timing expectations starved under contention at ~1.38s; separately a worker-crash run). The suite has grown from 1134 to 1354 tests this program, raising per-run CPU contention, so the wall-clock-sensitive quiesce tests (engineering-notes 2026-06-04) now flake more often. Durable fix: give SyncQuiesceMonitor the same injected-clock test discipline 3b introduced for ResetSignalMonitor (test clock seam; no wall-clock waits in assertions). Targeted isolation runs pass 3/3, confirming timing sensitivity, not logic.
